crossRefs.note: Behold, a man of God came out of Judah by Yahweh’s word to Bethel; and Jeroboam was standing by the altar to burn…
In every city of Judah he made high places to burn incense to other gods, and provoked Yahweh, the God of his fathers…
But we will certainly perform every word that has gone out of our mouth, to burn incense to the queen of the sky, and…
He made his son to pass through the fire, practiced sorcery, used enchantments, and dealt with those who had familiar…
Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, and didn’t keep his testimonies,

translations.web: and there they burned incense in all the high places, as the nations whom Yahweh carried away before them did; and they did wicked things to provoke Yahweh to anger;
translations.bsb: They burned incense on all the high places like the nations that the LORD had driven out before them. They did wicked things, provoking the LORD to anger.
translations.kjv: And there they burnt incense in all the high places, as did the heathen whom the LORD carried away before them; and wrought wicked things to provoke the LORD to anger:
translations.asv: and there they burnt incense in all the high places, as did the nations whom Jehovah carried away before them; and they wrought wicked things to provoke Jehovah to anger;
